sealSequence.description: Position of this posted transaction in its administration's seal chain, from 1. Written when the transaction is posted (ledger-sealed-entries REQ-LSE-001).
sealSequence.title: Seal sequence

previousSealHash.description: The seal hash of the previous transaction in the chain, or 64 zeros for the first one.

sealHash.description: SHA-256 of the previous seal hash and the canonical posted content (header and lines, state excluded).
sealHash.title: Seal hash
